descriptions.zh:
我们来到了一个欣欣向荣的行星。从茂密的森林到青翠的平原，这里的景色曾经丰富多彩，维护得一尘不染，一个生机勃勃的星球花园。

一个身份不明的植物类物种在半有机城市周围修建了大量防御设施。对当地恒星系统的扫描显示，这里被装备精良的战舰封锁。虽然没有发生冲突，但很明显，冲突正在酝酿之中。
descriptions.en:
We arrived on a thriving planet. From its dense forests to the verdant plains, the landscape was at once diverse and immaculately maintained - a vibrant and planet-wide garden.

An unidentified plantoid species has erected extensive fortifications around the semi-organic cities. Scans of the local star system have revealed a blockade of heavily equipped warships. There is no active conflict, but it is clear that one is brewing.

descriptions.zh:
在行星表面，我们遇到了一种巨大的生物，它的身体由复杂的根系网络组成。它用一种我们无法理解的语言表达着深刻而朴实的共鸣。然后它给了我们一棵幼苗，它轻轻地将自己固定在[Leader.GetName]的[Explorer.GetSpeciesHandName]上。它的抓握根由一种奇怪的材料制成。伸手去触碰[Explorer.GetNetworkName]，有一刻的瞬间意识；通过思想与根源的融合，建立了直接沟通的路径。

§E“你好，种子同胞。解释一下你是如何绕过封锁的，以及你来这里的目的。”§!
descriptions.en:
On the planet's surface, we encountered a massive creature whose body was formed by an intricate network of roots. It spoke with a deep, earthy resonance in a language we could not understand. It then offered us a seedling, which gently anchored itself to [Leader.GetName]'s [Explorer.GetSpeciesHandName]. Its grasping roots were formed of a strange material. Extending to touch [Explorer.GetNetworkName], there was a moment of instantaneous recognition; through the fusion of thought and root, a line of direct communication was established.

§E"Hail, seed kin. Explain how you bypassed the blockade, and for what purpose you have come."§!

descriptions.zh:
我们解释说，我们知道他们的物种：我们宇宙中的巴奥是和平主义者，蜂巢思维。他们是技艺无与伦比的园丁，却遭到了一个名叫古茹努尔的军国主义种族的攻击并最终被消灭。

从目前的情况来看，这个殖民地正面临着被燃烧殆尽的危险。

巴奥感到震惊。他们解释说，古茹努尔人最近才出现，在这个殖民地周围建立了军事封锁。我们报告的每一个细节都与他们迄今为止与古茹努尔的经历相符。

他们已正式请求我们协助击退外星人的威胁，以免为时已晚。
descriptions.en:
We explained that their species was known to us: the Baol in our universe were a pacifistic, hive mind. Gardeners of unmatched skill, they were attacked and finally exterminated by a militaristic race called the Grunur.

The way things stand, this colony is in danger of being burned to the ground.

The Baol were alarmed. They explained that the Grunur had appeared only recently, establishing a military blockade around this colony. Every detail of our report matched their own experience with the Grunur thus far.

They have made a formal request for our assistance in repelling the alien threat before it is too late.

所有巴奥星球行星和殖民地都被摧毁了。最终，只剩下一个巴奥个体，在一个废弃的研究站内被困了数千年。

巴奥感到震惊。他们解释说，古茹努尔人最近才出现，在这个殖民地周围建立了军事封锁。我们报告的每一个细节都与他们迄今为止与古茹努尔的经历相符。

descriptions.en:
We explained that their species was known to us: the Baol in our universe were a pacifistic, hive mind. Gardeners of unmatched skill, they were attacked and finally exterminated by a militaristic empire, the Grunur.

Every Baol planet and colony was destroyed. In the end, only a single Baol node remained, trapped for millenia inside an abandoned research station.

The Baol were alarmed. They explained that the Grunur had appeared only recently, establishing a military blockade around this colony. Every detail of our report matched their own experience with the Grunur thus far.

They have made a formal request for our assistance in repelling the alien threat before it is too late.

label.zh: 我们将尽我们所能提供帮助。
label.en: We will help however we can.
It is not our place to interfere.

descriptions.zh:
§E“我们正在为即将到来的战斗做好准备。遗憾的是，你们的探险可能比之前评估的要危险得多。”§!

植物类种族继续说到：§E“我们是§Y巴奥§!，你们在我们的一个外围殖民地上登陆。我们被围困了，资源日益减少。外交毫无结果。侵略者公然嘲笑我们试图沟通的努力。他们自称§Y古茹努尔§!。”§!

§E"我们相信他们的目标不是征服这个星球，而是毁灭它。他们似乎毫不留情。我们会礼貌地接受你们提供的任何援助。"§!
descriptions.en:
§E"We make preparations for a coming battle. Regrettably, your expedition may be much more dangerous than previously assessed."§!

The plantoid continued, §E"We are the §YBaol§!, and you have landed on one of our outer colonies. We are under siege, and our resources dwindle. Diplomacy is fruitless. The aggressors mock us openly, and laugh at our attempts to communicate. They identify themselves as the §YGrunur§!."§!

§E"We believe their aim is not to conquer this world, but to destroy it. It seems they know no mercy. We would graciously accept any assistance you can provide."§!

label.zh: 我们将尽我们所能提供帮助。
label.en: We will help however we can.
It is not our place to interfere.

descriptions.zh: 我们知道古茹努尔会把这个殖民地夷为平地。而且没有通过外交途径解决问题的机会。
descriptions.en: We know that the Grunur will burn this colony to the ground. There is no chance of a diplomatic resolution.

descriptions.zh: 我们知道古茹努尔在摧毁巴奥之前是不会停手的。而且没有通过外交途径解决问题的机会。
descriptions.en: We know that the Grunur will stop at nothing to destroy the Baol. There is no chance of a diplomatic resolution.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经与巴奥进行讨论确定提供援助的实用方法。
descriptions.en: We've engaged in discussions with the Baol to determine a practical way to lend aid.

descriptions.zh: 巴奥可以尝试自卫，但他们军事能力有限。他们可以从机械或基因增强中受益，以提高陆军的速度、力量和对燃烧武器的抵抗力。
descriptions.en: The Baol can attempt to defend themselves, but have limited military capabilities. They would benefit from mechanical or genetic enhancement to improve their armies' speed, strength and resistance to incendiary weapons.

descriptions.zh: 我们可以用临时隐形装置遮蔽他们的母星，从而帮助巴奥躲避古茹努尔。这个殖民地仍然会消失，但至少他们的文明所在地将会幸存。
descriptions.en: We may help the Baol evade the Grunur by obscuring their homeworld with a temporary cloaking device. This colony would still be lost, but at least the seat of their civilization will survive.

descriptions.zh: 我们可以尝试用星界丝缕来增强巴奥的先进有机技术。应该可以在这个殖民地周围建立一个强大的护盾。当然，这将使他们无法离开这颗行星，但至少他们也可以免受入侵者的侵害。
descriptions.en: We could attempt to enhance the Baol's advanced organic technology with astral thread. It should be possible to establish a powerful shield around this colony. Of course, this will prevent them from leaving the planet, but at least they would be safe from the invaders.

descriptions.zh: 作为最后的手段，我们可以将巴奥幼苗带回裂隙，无论这个维度发生什么，这个物种都将能够继续生存。
descriptions.en: As a last resort, we could carry Baol seedlings back through the Rift, allowing the species to live on no matter what happens in this dimension.

label.zh: 部署实验性行星隐形技术。

descriptions.zh:
巴奥的问题，无论是军事上还是别的，我们都不关心。我们应该从另一个维度去观察和探索；我们也不想树立新的强大敌人。

蜂巢思维明显失望地接受了我们的决定，但让我们继续研究。
descriptions.en:
The Baol's problems, military or otherwise, are not our concern. We have journeyed from another dimension to observe and explore; we have no desire to make new and powerful enemies.

The hive mind accepted our decision with obvious disappointment, but left us to continue our research.

descriptions.zh:
我们利用基因剪裁技术的知识来强化巴奥物种，让他们准备好迎接即将到来的防御战。由于几乎没有其他选择，他们不情愿地接受了这些生物学上的变化。和平的巴奥帝国以农业和生态系统管理为基础，现在拥有一支由具有强大体力的高复原力子个体组成的常备民兵。

现在，巴奥已经为地面战做好了更多准备，出于感激之情，他们为我们提供了一个防御个体。这种专门的、半自主的生物现在将为我们服务。
descriptions.en:
We used our knowledge of gene tailoring technology to fortify the Baol species in their upcoming defensive campaign. With few options left, they reluctantly accepted these changes to their biology. The pacifistic Baol empire, built on agriculture and ecosystem management, is now populated by a standing militia of highly resilient drones with tremendous physical strength.

Now more prepared for land warfare, the Baol have offered us a defensive node out of gratitude. This specialized, semi-autonomous creature will now serve us.

descriptions.zh:
§H植物类种族个体的移动速度缓慢，但如果它行动迟缓是因为他们缺乏智慧，那可就大错特错。这种个体专门用于保卫集体，代表了几代精心适应的顶峰。它们冷酷而礼貌地向我们打招呼，一心想要对我们给予它们蜂巢的恩惠做出回报。§!

作为巴奥的一部分，我们没有名字。你可以称呼我们为橡树茎。
descriptions.en:
§HThe plantoid node moves with slow deliberation, but it would be a mistake to take its lumbering for lack of intelligence. Specialized to defend the collective, this organism represents the pinnacle of generations of careful adaptation. They greet us grimly, but politely, intent on repaying the favor we bestowed upon their hive.§!

As part of the Baol, we had no name. You may call us Oakenstalk.

descriptions.zh:
在与巴奥分享隐形领域的秘密后，他们就能生产出有机隐形卫星阵列。这些实验性分枝本质短寿，并且需要少量的星界丝缕来维持，但它们应该持续足够撑到将巴奥的母星隐藏在古茹努尔的视野之外。不幸的是，这个殖民地已经为古茹努尔人所知，并且很可能是注定要灭亡的。

一旦隐形，巴奥将不得不暂时牺牲其星际旅行的雄心壮志，因为只要有飞船从母星出发的飞船都有可能会暴露其位置。当然，这种不便还是比毁灭要好得多的。
descriptions.en:
After sharing the secrets of the cloaking field with the Baol, they were able to produce an array of organic cloaking satellites. These experimental offshoots are temporary in nature, and require a small amount of astral thread to maintain, but they should last long enough to hide the Baol homeworld from the Grunur. Unfortunately, this colony is already known to the Grunur, and is likely doomed.

Once cloaked, the Baol will have to sacrifice their space-faring ambitions for the time being, as any ship sighted departing from the homeworld may reveal its location. Of course, this inconvenience is infinitely preferable to annihilation.

descriptions.zh:
离开巴奥殖民地时，我们被托付了一捆珍贵的幼苗。

如果巴奥和古茹努尔之间的冲突进一步升级，至少我们能够从战争的蹂躏中拯救他们的一些物种。
descriptions.en:
Departing the Baol colony, we were entrusted with a bundle of their precious seedlings.

If the conflict between the Baol and the Grunur escalates further, at least we were able to rescue some of their species from the ravages of war.

descriptions.zh:
离开巴奥殖民地时，我们被托付了一捆珍贵的幼苗。

当巴奥不可避免地被毁灭时，也许他们会因知道他们的物种将在另一个维度生存而感到慰藉。
descriptions.en:
Departing the Baol colony, we were entrusted with a bundle of their precious seedlings.

When the Baol are inevitably destroyed, perhaps they will take comfort in the knowledge that their species will live on in another dimension.

descriptions.zh:
离开巴奥殖民地时，我们被托付了一捆珍贵的幼苗。

我们希望他们的冲突能够尽快结束，巴奥能够在裂隙两边都繁荣昌盛。
descriptions.en:
Departing the Baol colony, we were entrusted with a bundle of their precious seedlings.

We hope that their conflict will end soon and that the Baol will live on prosperously on both sides of the rift.

descriptions.zh:
我们准备了观测卫星并将它们发射到星球轨道上，这将使我们能够跨越裂隙传输一些数据。

现在，我们将研究巴奥先进的农业和生态系统管理技术。当那天真的来临的时候，我们还将捕捉到古茹努尔毁灭行星的关键镜头。
descriptions.en:
We prepared our observation satellites and launched them into terrestrial orbit, which should allow us to transmit some amount of data across the rift.

For now, we will study the Baol's advanced agriculture and ecosystem management techniques. When the time comes, we will also capture crucial footage of the planet's annihilation by the Grunur.

label.zh: 这是一个独特的研究机会。
label.en: This is a unique research opportunity.

descriptions.zh:
我们准备了观测卫星并将它们发射到星球轨道上，这将使我们能够跨越裂隙传输一些数据。

他们的冲突开始之前，我们可以研究巴奥尔星球及其生态系统管理。同时这场战争也应该为未来的研究提供有趣的数据点。
descriptions.en:
We prepared our observation satellites and launched them into terrestrial orbit, which should allow us to transmit some amount of data across the rift.

We will study the Baol planet and their ecosystem management until their conflict begins. This war should also provide interesting data points for future research.

label.zh: 这是一个独特的研究机会。
label.en: This is a unique research opportunity.

descriptions.zh: 远离裂隙一端，位于[From.solar_system.GetName]的巴奥殖民地已被古茹努尔摧毁。我们从战斗中收集了详细的研究数据，但这个观测项目的目标已经被消除了。
descriptions.en: The Baol colony on the far side of the rift in [From.solar_system.GetName] has been destroyed by the Grunur. We gathered detailed research data from battle, but the target of this observation project has been eliminated.

descriptions.zh:
通过将星界丝缕整合到巴奥的防御技术中，我们在他们被围困的殖民地周围投射了一种反应式、但很坚固的行星护盾。护盾将包围行星并保护巴奥，只要它还存在。

希望它能存在足够长的时间，让古茹努尔继续前往更容易接近的目标。
descriptions.en:
By integrating astral thread into the Baol's defensive technology, we have projected a reactive yet sturdy form of planetary shielding around their besieged colony. The barrier will surround the planet and protect the Baol for as long as it stands.

Hopefully, it will survive long enough for the Grunur to move on to more accessible targets.

descriptions.zh:
我们进入盖亚行星轨道，立即遇到了巡逻的战舰。我们试图沟通，回应我们的却是沉默。

一支巡逻队护送我们前往他们的旗舰，这是一艘装备齐全的主宰，周围有数十艘支援船。当我们的§Y裂隙探球§!降落在一个大机库时，我们立即被一队士兵拘留。它们的甲壳和锯齿状的钳子让人想起几种已知的甲壳类动物。他们迈着完美的步调向前行进，呈现出一种令人畏惧的形象，但从他们的铠甲头上伸出的圆圆的眼睛却显得机警而聪明。

我们认为这个物种就是§Y古茹努尔§!，一个数十万年前生活在我们宇宙中的高度侵略性的种族。众所周知，这个物种对被称为§Y巴奥§!的植物类蜂巢思维物种进行了灭绝。我们假设这个裂隙将我们置于一个平行宇宙中，古茹努尔在其中仍然保持着军事活跃。
descriptions.en:
We entered orbit around the Gaia planet and were immediately confronted by patrolling warships. Our attempts at communication were met with silence.

A patrol escorted us to their flagship, a heavily outfitted Juggernaut surrounded by dozens of support vessels. Landing our §YRift Sphere§! in a large hangar, we were immediately taken into custody by a squad of soldiers. Their armored carapaces and jagged pincers recalled several known species of crustacean. Marching forward in perfect lock-step, they presented an intimidating image, but the beady eyes protruding from their armored heads were alert and intelligent.

We recognized the species as the §YGrunur§!, a highly aggressive race that lived in our universe hundreds thousands of years ago. Famously, this species was responsible for the genocide of the plantoid hive mind known as the §YBaol§!. We hypothesize that this rift has deposited us in a parallel universe in which the Grunur remain militarily active.

descriptions.zh:
我们被引导到一个中央房间。一个复杂的控制面板容纳了几种巨大的甲壳类动物，它们的钳子以惊人的精度插入到一个专门的接口中。每个终端都包含大量的水晶，显然是通过工作人员胸腔深处产生的声音操纵的。房间中央站着一位身穿破烂军装的舰队司令。它发出一声命令，它的属下立即开始行动。

我们的一个无人机被立即拘束并扫描。一个锋利的仪器直接刺入了它的中央处理单元，使其失去了活力。处理单元很快被传递给甲壳类领袖，后者将其插入命令控制台上的一个水晶中。

水晶中响起了清脆的声音，用我们的母语说到：§E谈时已到。汝皆何人？§!
descriptions.en:
We were shepherded into a central chamber. A complex control panel housed several massive crustaceans, their pincers slotted with remarkable precision into a specialized interface. Each terminal contained a font of crystals, apparently manipulated by the sounds produced from deep within the crew members' chests. In the center of the room stood an admiral in tattered regalia. It barked a command, and its subordinates broke into action.

One of our research drones was summarily restrained and scanned. A sharp instrument was plunged directly into its CPU, rendering it inert. The processing unit was quickly passed to the crustacean leader, who inserted it into one of the crystals on their command console.

A ringing voice resonated out from the crystals in our native language: §E"IT IS TIME FOR TALKING. WHO ARE YOU?"§!

descriptions.zh:
我们介绍自己是来自平行宇宙的科学家。

在我们的世界里，古茹努尔早已消失。根据考古记录，他们是一个征服者的种族，拥有大量先进的武器……并且有残忍倾向。他们消灭巴奥的行动无论是效率还是场面都堪称传奇。他们注定要毁灭这个星系中的巴奥殖民地。

当我们的话语被翻译时，古茹努尔士兵发出一连串的喘息声。我们认为这是他们的笑声。然而，舰队领袖的固执沉默很快又恢复了礼仪。通过翻译水晶，它说道：

§E“知晓，然后？如若知晓，便会给予。”§!
descriptions.en:
We introduce ourselves as scientists from a parallel universe.

In our world, the Grunur have long since disappeared. Based on the archaeological record, they were a race of conquerors, possessing a vast arsenal of advanced weaponry... as well as a tendency for cruelty. Their extermination of the Baol is legendary both for its efficacy as well as its spectacle. They are destined to destroy the Baol colony in this system.

As our words were translated, the Grunur soldiers emitted a series of popping gasps. We took this to be their version of laughter. However, the obstinate silence of the ship's leader soon restored decorum. Through the translation crystal, it spoke:

§E"KNOWING, THEN? IF KNOWING IS, THEN GIVING WILL BE."§!

descriptions.zh:
我们解释说，我们是来自另一个维度的研究人员，我们的使命是探索改变宇宙以及宇宙中存在的各种现象。

当我们陈述我们的意图时，海军上将轻蔑地哼了一声。我们周围的士兵变得焦躁不安、喧闹起来，发出大声的叫喊声和呱呱声。
§E看到，然后？见证已毕。乞愿将始。§!
descriptions.en:
We explained that we were researchers from another dimension on a mission to explore alternate universes and the various phenomena that exist within them.

The admiral grunted dismissively as we stated our intentions. The soldiers around us grew restless and raucous, ululating and croaking loudly.

§E"LOOKING, THEN? SEEING IS DONE. BEGGING BEGINS."§!

label.zh: 虚张声势地回应。不要被吓倒。
label.en: Respond with bravado. Do not be intimidated.

descriptions.zh:
我们向古茹努尔舰队司令分享了有关人造龙鳞装甲的研究数据。几乎立刻，对抗的气氛就减弱了。古茹努尔显然对我们对先进战争的承诺印象深刻。

他们计划在即将到来的灭绝行动中使用该技术。为了表达谢意，舰队司令赠送了我们一块数据水晶。从所提供的解释中，我们了解到它包含宝贵的军事机密，包括我们之前所未知的策略和技术。它还包括对古茹努尔军事历史的详尽描述——一份长达数百卷的记录——或许对我们来说也没什么用。
descriptions.en:
We shared our research data on Artificial Dragonscales with the Grunur admiral. Almost immediately, the air of confrontation waned. The Grunur were obviously impressed with our commitment to advanced warfare.

They plan to use the technology in their upcoming extermination campaign. As a show of gratitude, the admiral gifted us a data crystal. From the explanation provided, we understand it contains valuable military secrets, including previously unknown stratagems and techniques. Perhaps less helpfully, it also includes a meticulously detailed account of the Grunur's military history - a record that spans hundreds of volumes.

他们计划在即将到来的灭绝行动中使用该技术。为了表达谢意，舰队司令赠送了我们一块数据水晶。从所提供的解释中，我们了解到它包含宝贵的军事机密，包括我们之前所未知的策略和技术。它还包括对古茹努尔军事历史的详尽描述——一份长达数百卷的记录——或许对我们来说也没什么用。
descriptions.en:
We shared our research data on Skravird Strike Craft with the Grunur admiral. Almost immediately, the air of confrontation waned. The Grunur were obviously impressed with our commitment to advanced warfare.

They plan to use the technology in their upcoming extermination campaign. As a show of gratitude, the admiral gifted us a data crystal. From the explanation provided, we understand it contains valuable military secrets, including previously unknown stratagems and techniques. Perhaps less helpfully, it also includes a meticulously detailed account of the Grunur's military history - a record that spans hundreds of volumes.

descriptions.zh:
古茹努尔非常感谢我们能够分享有关巴奥的信息。鉴于他们的种族对间谍活动和其他间接战争方法缺乏兴趣，我们的信息无疑将帮助他们在即将到来的灭绝期间完善他们的策略。

尽管如此，他们的海军上将仍然保持警惕：

§E"知晓诚可贵，见证才更佳。目睹灭绝事，方知学无涯。"§!
descriptions.en:
The Grunur appreciated what we were able to share about the Baol. Given their species' lack of interest in espionage and other methods of indirect warfare, our information will undoubtedly help them to refine their strategy during the upcoming extermination.

Despite this, their admiral remained guarded:

§E"KNOWING IS, BUT SEEING IS BETTER. WITNESS EXTERMINATION, THEN MORE LEARNING."§!

descriptions.zh:
这是一个冒险的举动，但我们的勇敢得到了回报。古茹努尔的指挥官对我们通过裂隙探球在宇宙之间穿梭的故事印象特别深刻。看来，展现勇敢和英勇是古茹努尔人的典型特征。对他们来说，对话总是有赢家和输家——而这次对话显然为我们赢得了一些分数。我们甚至亲眼目睹了一些钳子发出的咔哒声表示赞同。

最终，领导者带着一连串有节奏的嘎嘎声从终端站起来。

§E“勇敢固好，行动最佳。时机已至，赢取尊重。”§!

一根水晶竖井矗立在我们面前，和指挥控制台周围竖立的竖井类似。

§E"发射开始。等待命令。"§!
descriptions.en:
It was a risky gambit, but our bravado paid off. The Grunur general was particularly impressed by our tales of slipping between universes via the Rift Sphere. It seems that such displays of bravery and prowess are typical things for the Grunur. To them, a conversation always has a winner and a loser - and this dialogue had apparently scored us some points. We even witnessed some pincers clacking in approval.

Eventually, the leader rose from their terminal with a series of measured croaks.

§E"BRAVERY IS, BUT DOING IS BEST. RESPECT TO BE GAINED."§!

A crystalline shaft rose before us, similar to the ones erected around the command console.

§E"LAUNCHING BEGINS. ORDER AWAITS."§!

label.en: Press the crystal. Order the launch.

descriptions.zh:
古茹努尔根本就没有兴趣听我们解释。

舰队司令从终端那站起来，并发出一连串的嘎嘎声，其中夹杂着钳子发出的尖锐的折断声。

§E"审判结束。惩戒开始。"§!

我们被带到一间牢房。从我们警卫的“笑声”来看，我们的命运不太可能是美好的。我们的设备正被拿走。这将是我们最后的传输。

愿我们的家人幸福安康。
descriptions.en:
The Grunur were simply not interested in listening to reason.

The admiral rose from the terminal with a series of croaks, punctuated with sharp snaps from their pincers.

§E"JUDGMENT IS. PUNISHMENT AWAITS."§!

We were led to a holding cell. Based on the 'laughter' of our guards, our fate is unlikely to be a pretty one. Our equipment is being taken. This will be our last transmission.

Send our best to our families.

descriptions.zh:
古茹努尔档案已得到全面分析。

读起来令人不安。他们的军功无疑是残酷的。

然而，我们发现了他们的宇航技术的一个独特的先进方面，这可能会彻底改变我们当前的武器系统。虽然是为古茹努尔的生理特性设计的，但我们可以适应界面，这可以提高瞄准精度。

虽然我们希望永远不需要它，但它将有助于我们的自卫。
descriptions.en:
The Grunur archive has been fully analyzed.

It made for disturbing reading. Their military exploits are decidedly sadistic.

However, we discovered one uniquely advanced aspect of their voidcraft design which could revolutionize our current weapons systems. While designed for Grunur biology, we can adapt the interface to improve our targeting accuracy.

While we hope it will never be required, it will aid our self-defense.

这个新界面将给我们带来决定性的战斗优势，让我们能够更彻底地压制敌人。

然而，我们发现了他们的宇航技术的一个独特的先进方面，这可能会彻底改变我们当前的武器系统。虽然是为古茹努尔的生理特性设计的，但我们可以适应界面，这可以提高瞄准精度。

这个新界面将给我们带来决定性的战斗优势，让我们能够更彻底地压制敌人。
descriptions.en:
The Grunur archive has been fully analyzed.

It made for disturbing reading. Their military exploits are decidedly sadistic. We appreciate the Grunur's delight in exterminating inferior species.

However, we discovered one uniquely advanced aspect of their voidcraft design which could revolutionize our current weapons systems. While designed for Grunur biology, we can adapt the interface to improve our targeting accuracy.

This new interface will give us a decided edge in combat and allow us to more thoroughly dominate our enemies.

我们看着古茹努尔开始轰炸巴奥殖民地。他们舰队的压倒性优势迅速摧毁了巴奥脆弱的防御。

当古茹努尔陆军袭击行星表面时，一切都陷入了熊熊大火。配备火焰喷射器的部队以可怕的效率焚烧了当地的植物。

不可避免的胜利缓解了古茹努尔海军上将的嘶哑声。

§E“我见。我烧。知晓，现在？"§!

袭击中使用的火焰武器样本已被拿出来供我们检查。

§E“涤火皆净。汝可拿去。汝敌皆惧。"§!
descriptions.en:
We watched as the Grunur began their bombardment of the Baol colony. The overwhelming superiority of their fleet swiftly demolished the Baol's feeble defenses.

As the Grunur brigades stormed the planet's surface, all was set to flame. Troops armed with flamethrowers incinerated the native plantoids with terrible efficiency.

The inevitable victory softened the Grunur admiral's croaks.

§E"SEEING IS. BURNING IS. KNOWING, NOW?"§!

A sample of the flame weaponry used in the attack was brought forth for our inspection.

§E"BURNING IS CLEAN. TAKE. MAKE FEAR."§!

descriptions.zh:
我们在[solar_system.GetName]裂缝彼端的科学官正被古茹努尔所俘虏。

星界锚索已被收回，§Y裂隙探球§!已返回。最终数据日志的下载已经在进行中。
descriptions.en:
Our scientists beyond the rift in [solar_system.GetName] are being held captive by the Grunur.

The anchor cable has been retracted, and the §YRift Sphere§! retrieved. Download of the final data logs is already in progress.

我们只能希望古茹努尔能够对探球的船员表示怜悯。谁能说呢？世界之间的裂隙鲜为人知……如果幸运的话，他们甚至可能找到回去的路。
descriptions.en:
Our scientists beyond the rift in [solar_system.GetName] are being held captive by the Grunur.

The anchor cable has been retracted, and the §YRift Sphere§! retrieved. Download of the final data logs is already in progress.

We can only hope that the Grunur will show mercy to the Sphere's crew. And who can say? The rifts between the worlds are little understood... Perhaps, given luck, they may even find a way back.

descriptions.zh: §Y[Leader.GetName]§!意外地从§Y[From.solar_system.GetName]§!星界裂隙另一侧的古茹努尔舰队内的拘留所返回。[Leader.GetHisHer]的年龄似乎无法确定，只能推测出介于两个时间点之间。作为古茹努尔的奴隶，[Leader.GetHeShe]精通设计用于星际战斗的新武器。
descriptions.en: §Y[Leader.GetName]§! [Leader.GetHasHave] unexpectedly returned from [Leader.GetHisHer] detention within the Grunur fleet on the other side of the Astral Rift in §Y[From.solar_system.GetName]§!. Caught somewhere between this time and another, [Leader.GetHisHer] age seems indeterminable. Kept as a slave by the Grunur, [Leader.GetHeShe] [Leader.GetHasHave] become well-versed in designing new weapons for interstellar combat.

descriptions.zh:
我们到达了一个郁郁葱葱的热带星球的大气层。植物群色素浓郁，肿胀的软体动物在果树间滑行。

一种非典型的粉红色薄雾偶尔会穿过万花筒般的树冠。

考虑到树叶的密度，我们需要继续从地面进行观察。
descriptions.en:
We arrived in the atmosphere of a lush, tropical planet. The flora is intensely pigmented and swollen molluscoids slither among the fruit-bearing trees.

An atypical pink haze occasionally bursts through the kaleidoscopic canopy.

Given the density of the foliage, we will need to continue our observations from the ground.

descriptions.zh:
着陆后，我们发现地形上有一条裂缝，隐藏在薄薄的壤土下面。我们从上面观察到的琥珀色气体在下面更加集中。我们推测这个开口是行星核心深处先前活跃的气孔。

从这里开始，植被种类繁多，树木茂盛，果实累累。成群的球状、笨重的蛞蝓慢慢地爬过丛林，心满意足地吃东西，或者睡在营养丰富的土壤上，他们周围都是他们的幼崽。
descriptions.en:
Upon landing, we exposed a crack in the terrain, hidden under thin layers of loam. The amber-colored gas we had observed from above is even more heavily concentrated below. We speculate this opening was a previously active vent from deep within the planet's core.

From here, the vegetation's variety is dizzying and dense with fruit-laden trees. Herds of bulbous, lumbering slugs slowly crawl through the jungle, eating contentedly or sleeping on the nutrient-dense soil surrounded by litters of their younglings.

label.zh: 对粉红色气体进行取样。

descriptions.zh:
我们从行星上的动物群中收集了各种各样的样本。这里的生命完全没有侵略性；我们遇到的每一种生物都是草食性的。这种类似蛞蝓的软体动物消耗大量的植物物质，并且可以在其斑驳的绿色外套下储存密集的脂肪。

动物群的多样性非常独特；在典型的生态系统中，很容易进化出一种捕猎这些简单的猎物的物种。我们相信，这些动物的温顺本性是在无处不在的粉红色气体中发现的奇怪有机化合物的结果。调查这些元素的来源有望揭示更多信息。
descriptions.en:
We have collected a wide variety of samples from the planet's fauna. The life here is wholly unaggressive; every creature we've encountered is herbivorous. The slug-like molluscs consume huge quantities of plant matter and can store dense pockets of fat under their patchy green mantle.

The diversity of fauna is significantly peculiar; in a typical ecosystem, a species would have evolved to take advantage of such easy prey. We believe that the docile nature of these animals is a result of strange organic compounds found in the omnipresent pink gas. Investigating the source of these elements will hopefully reveal more information.

descriptions.zh:
我们在这个星球上发现的气体被证明具有危险的致幻特性。我们对在球体之外度过的时光的记忆充其量是模糊的。然而，我们通过检查我们的套装相机的记录，成功地拼凑出了我们的探险经历。

我们在朦胧的外星世界生机勃勃的平原上漫无目的地徘徊了一段时间。我们感觉每一步都是一个伟大的发现；美丽的植物、在空地上漫步的心满意足的软体动物、美味的水果——我们如饥似渴地享用着这些。空气中的醉人物质给我们的探险带来了巨大成功的感觉，尽管收获甚少。

我们防护服中的过滤器不足以保护我们免受这种气体的侵害。幸运的是，我们中的一些人跌跌撞撞地回到了§Y裂隙探球§!的庇护所，在那里我们能够恢复我们的知觉。虽然感觉好像我们才刚刚离开，但我们已经探索了好几天了。

不用提醒，我们将致力于增强我们的呼吸设备，以完成余下的调查。
descriptions.en:
The gas we found on this planet turned out to have dangerous hallucinogenic properties. Our memory of the time we spent outside the Sphere is hazy at best. However, we have managed to piece together our expedition by examining recordings of our suit cameras.

We wandered aimlessly for some time across the vibrant plains of the hazy alien world. It felt to us as if each step was a magnificent discovery; a beautiful plant, a contented mollusc wandering in a clearing, a delicious fruit - we feasted hungrily upon those. The  intoxicating substance in the air bestowed a feeling of great success in our expedition, despite having so few productive results.

The filters in our suits were not enough to protect us from this gas. Luckily, some us stumbled back into the shelter of the §YRift Sphere§! and were able to recover our senses. Though it felt as if we had only just left, we had been exploring for days.

Needless to say, we will endeavor to enhance our respiratory equipment for the remainder of our investigations.

label.en: Find the source of this gas.

descriptions.zh:
我们采集了悬浮在行星表面的粉红色薄雾样本，并在分子水平上进行了分析。

这种气体具有强大的致幻作用，可以使各种生物生命变得温顺和自我满足。在它的影响下，一个易受影响的智慧个体只会尝试满足其最基本的需求，同时感受到巨大的成就感。

此外，它的空气中的化合物通过影响吸入它的人的体内天然激素的生产力来促进脂肪的形成。由于对营养分配和自身免疫反应的控制较弱，这反过来又增加了受影响生物的食欲。久而久之，其结果将是无休止的过度消化的正反馈循环。我们可以根据酶的痕迹确认这种气体是生物产生的，但我们无法找到产生这种气体的动物。

这种安抚物质不会对我们的生物造成任何风险。即使它的浓度非常高，也只会对我们产生轻微影响。
descriptions.en:
We took a sample of the pink haze suspended across the planet's surface and analyzed it on a molecular level.

The gas has a powerful mind-numbing effect that can render all manner of biological life docile and self-satisfied. Under its influence, a susceptible intelligent entity will only attempt to satisfy its most basic needs, all while feeling a great sense of accomplishment.

Additionally, its airborne compounds encourage fat development by affecting the production of natural hormones in those that inhale it. This in turn increases the affected creature's appetite due to weaker control over nutrient distribution and autoimmune responses. Over time, the result would be an endless reinforcement cycle of over-consumption. We can confirm that the gas is biologically produced based on traces of enzymes, but we have been unable to locate the animal producing it.

This mollifying substance poses no risk to our biology. Even an incredibly dense concentration of it would only slightly affect us.

descriptions.zh:
利用空气质量传感器，我们在茂密的土地上寻找有毒气体的最高局部浓度。越过一片长满浆果的灌木丛，我们被带到了一片空地中央的一个巨大裂缝的入口处。浓浓的粉红色瘴气从其中不规则地散发出来。

我们相信这种气体是由这条裂缝底部某处的地下生物产生的。找到它，最好是活着的，可以提供独特的研究机会。
descriptions.en:
Utilizing an air quality sensor, we searched for the highest localized concentrations of the toxic gas across the lush lands. Beyond a patch of berry-laden shrubberies, we were led to the mouth of a vast crevasse in the center of a clearing. Waves of the thick, pink miasma emanated from it in irregular intervals.

We believe that the gas is being produced by a subterranean creature somewhere at the base of this fissure. Finding it, preferably alive, could provide unique research opportunities.

label.zh: 谨慎一些。挖掘裂口周围。
label.en: Use caution. Excavate around the chasm.

descriptions.zh:
我们将§Y裂隙探球§!的样本收集装置改装成挖掘工具，并用它来挖开裂缝的入口。切开一层厚厚的潮湿的黄色覆盖物后，我们发现了一层新的土壤。它呈赭色，在我们挖掘时破裂成鳞片状的层状碎片，在最轻微的机械搅拌下释放出少量的粉红色气体。

虽然这层土壤含有高浓度的有机化合物，但它还不足以成为有机化合物的来源。

随着挖掘的深入，收割工具就刺穿了更暗、更加深红色的土壤层。就在这时，地面猛然颤动。厚厚的粉红色气体云从我们凿出的凿痕中涌出。然后，这片黑暗的大地就像活了一样移动了。

我们的收割工具迅速被猩红的泥土包裹，并被粉碎成碎片。我们周围的地表震动越来越剧烈，我们退回到高层大气中。

这里不再欢迎我们。
descriptions.en:
We've refitted the §YRift Sphere§!'s sample collection apparatus into an excavation tool, and used it to dig away the mouth of the chasm. After cutting through a thick layer of moist yellow mulch, we discovered a new layer of soil. Ochre in color, it broke into scale-like layered fragments as we dug, releasing small bursts of trapped pink gas from the slightest mechanical agitation.

While this layer of soil contained high concentrations of organic compounds, it was not nearly enough to have been the source.

Digging deeper, the harvesting tool then pierced through a darker, more crimson colored soil layer. At this, the ground erupted violently. Thick clouds of pink gas poured forth from the gouge we had made. This darker earth then moved as if it were alive.

Our harvesting tool was rapidly enveloped in scarlet earth, and crushed to scrap. The surface around us shook with increasingly violent tremors, and we retreated back into the upper atmosphere.

We are no longer welcome here.

descriptions.zh:
我们带着简单的攀爬装备进入裂口，寻找下面的生物。当我们下降时，矿化墙从潮湿的黄色土壤转变为鳞片状的深粉色土壤。再往下，一切都变成了脉动的深红色。

当我们继续下降时，浓浓的粉红色气体喷发覆盖了我们。到达底部后，我们发现了它的来源：一个横跨裂缝直径的网状帷幕，悬挂着一个口腔，孔口的中心有一个几丁质的、喙状的口腔。从这个生物身上，一根粗脉管蜿蜒深入岩石。

我们发现了肉食生命，它可能就是星球本身。
descriptions.en:
We entered the chasm with rudimentary climbing gear in search of the creature below. As we descended, the mineralized walls transitioned from a moist yellow soil to a scaly, dark pink one. Further down, all became pulsating crimson.

Eruptions of thick pink gas covered us as we continued our descent. Reaching the bottom, we discovered its source: a webbed curtain stretched across the chasm's diameter, suspending an orifice with a chitinous, beak-like mouth at its center. From this creature, a thickly-veined tube snaked its way further into the rock.

We have found carnivorous life, and it may be the planet itself.

descriptions.zh:
我们切断了从深红色岩石中伸出的中央管的口腔，并开始升回地面。

作为回应，裂缝的墙壁剧烈震动，浓浓的生物气体淹没了隧道。我们感觉到整个密室都在摇晃，随着我们接近地面，出口也变得越来越小。它——无论“它”是什么——正试图吞噬我们。

幸运的是，当擦过我们天生有毒的身体时，血肉般的深红色墙壁反射性地向后退开。我们毫发无伤地逃脱了。到达地表后，裂缝就封闭了，在空地上留下了一道细小的疤痕。我们周围的地面震动得越来越剧烈，促使我们赶紧返回高层大气。

这里不再欢迎我们。
descriptions.en:
We severed the mouth from the central tube jutting out of the crimson rock and began our ascent.

The walls of the chasm shook violently in response and a concentrated biological gas flooded the tunnel. We felt the entire chamber shake, and the way out grew smaller and smaller as we approached the surface. It - whatever "it" may be - was attempting to swallow us.

In a fortunate turn of events, the flesh-like crimson walls recoiled reflexively away when brushing against our naturally toxic bodies. We escaped unharmed. Upon reaching the surface, the crevasse sealed shut, leaving a fine scar across the clearing. The ground around us shook with increasingly violent tremors, prompting us to hurry back into the upper atmosphere.

We are no longer welcome here.

descriptions.zh:
我们分析了收集到的奇特的粉红色土壤，并证实了更广泛的矿物生物有机体的存在。我们相信，这种材料和粉碎我们工具的深红色物质都是同一个生物的一部分——行星本身。我们的假设是，这个感性行星创造了自己的生态系统，旨在不断为其提供高营养和顺从的牲口。

土壤具有显着的肥沃特性，并解释了行星表面植被的极端密度。我们已经能够将其中的一些原则应用到我们自己的耕作方法中。
descriptions.en:
We analyzed the peculiar pink soil that we collected and confirmed the existence of a wider mineral-based biological organism. We believe that this material and the crimson substance that crushed our tool is all part of the same living being - the planet itself. Our hypothesis is that this sentient planet manufactured its own ecosystem designed to continuously provide it with highly nutritious and submissive livestock.

The soil has remarkable fertilization properties and explains the extreme density of the vegetation on the planet's surface. We have been able to apply some of its principles to our own farming methods.

descriptions.zh:
为了不打扰有机体，我们迅速从裂口脉动的墙壁上收集了三种土壤类型的样本，然后离开了行星，没有发生进一步的事故。

我们分析了收集到的样本并证实了我们的怀疑——行星本身是有生命的。

黄色表土营养丰富，可用于为快速营养生长提供肥料。鳞片状的粉红色矿物层是一种将有毒气体有效分布到整个星球表面的载体。最后，深红色物质有效地充当行星的循环系统，能够将矿物质和有机资源重新分配到最需要的地方。

我们遇到的裂口肯定是消化道，我们很幸运没有被吃掉。

无论如何，我们已经能够将表土的卓越肥沃特性应用到我们自己的耕作方法中。我们在星界位面中遇到的这种独特的生命形式将在未来几年内得到研究。
descriptions.en:
Careful to not disturb the organism, we quickly collected samples of the three soil types from the chasm's pulsating walls and left the planet without further incident.

We analyzed the samples that we collected and confirmed our suspicions - the planet itself is alive.

The yellow topsoil is highly nutrient-dense and used to fertilize the rapid vegetative growth. The scaly pink mineral layer is a vehicle to distribute the intoxicating gas efficiently across the planet's entire surface. Finally, the crimson material effectively serves as the planet's circulatory system, able to redistribute minerals and organic resources where they are needed the most.

The chasm we encountered was certainly a digestive tract, and we were lucky to not have been eaten.

Regardless, we have been able to apply the remarkable fertilization properties of the topsoil to our own farming methods. This unique form of life we have encountered within the astral planes will be studied for years to come.

descriptions.zh:
经过对切断的消化器官进行大量实验，我们对这个星球的生态系统有了更深入的了解。首先，整个行星都是有生命的——土壤和一切。

口腔消化道内有充满高度浓缩生物材料的囊，这些生物材料可以蒸发到较低的大气中。这种气体的目的是让生活在其表面的动物增肥，并防止其他掠食者进化。然后，陶醉的猎物会通过类似于我们遇到的那个大开口被行星吞噬。我们所复原的嘴巴只是数千张口腔中的一张。

我们已经学会了如何合成复制粉红色气体，以及在实际应用中改变它的特性，用作我们外交官的信息素。尽管浓度大大降低，但它仍然对大多数天然生物保持强大的镇静作用。
descriptions.en:
After extensive experiments with the severed digestive organ, we have gained further insight into the ecosystem of this planet. To begin with, the entire planet is alive - soil and all.

Contained within the mouth's digestive tract are sacs full of highly concentrated biological material that can be vaporized up into the lower atmosphere. This gas is designed to fatten up the animals that live on its surface and prevent other predators from evolving. The intoxicated prey are then consumed by the planet via large openings similar to the one we encountered. The mouth we have recovered is but one of thousands.

We have learned how to synthetically reproduce and alter the properties of the pink gas into a practical application for use as a pheromone for our diplomats. Though at a highly reduced concentration, it still maintains a strong mollifying effect to most natural biologies.

descriptions.zh:
我们到达了一个冰冻多山的星球。

不久之后，我们的电路就被外星传输震惊了：

§E“你们好，远道而来的人们。从我的冥想深处，我感知到了你们穿越星界的旅程。来吧，让我们见面吧。也许你们的到来，就是我一直在等待的突破。”

§!我们收到了一组到行星远端的坐标。

无论这是谁，他们的灵能都远远超过了我们的能力。
descriptions.en:
We arrived in the atmosphere of a frozen, mountainous world.

It was not long before our circuits were shaken by a foreign transmission:

§E"Greetings, you who have traveled so far. From the depths of my meditations, I sensed your journey across the Astral Planes. Come, let us meet. Perhaps your arrival is the breakthrough I have been waiting for."

§!A set of coordinates to the far side of the planet were provided.

Whoever this is, their psionic powers far surpass anything we are capable of.

descriptions.zh:
我们将视野锁定到行星上最高的山脉之一的一个点。

一个蒙面人坐在一个偏僻的山洞里冥想。她是有着灰色的皮肤的人形生物，被一种柔和脉动的能量的紫色光环笼罩着。

我们认出这个外星人就是泽珞族。数百万年前，这个具有灵能天赋的种族生活在我们自己的宇宙中，直到内战导致他们的物种完全灭绝。也许这个裂隙是通往平行时间线的大门，在这个时间线中，泽珞族还没有飞升到虚境之中。

我们收到了另一个通讯：

§E“谢谢你接受我的邀请，我们有很多事情要讨论。”

“我被称为先知。多年来我一直在这些冰冻荒原冥想，等待启示。你出现在这里并非偶然。”§!
descriptions.en:
We traced the vision to a point on one of the planet's highest mountains.

A masked figure sat meditating in an isolated cave. Gray-skinned and humanoid, she was enveloped in a violet aura of gently pulsing energy.

We recognized the alien as a Zroni. Millions of years ago, this psionically gifted race lived in our own universe, before a civil war resulted in the complete extinction of their species. Perhaps this rift was a doorway to a parallel timeline in which the Zroni have not yet ascended into the Shroud.

We received another communication:

§E"Thank you for accepting my invitation, we have much to discuss."

"I am known as the Far-Seer. I have been meditating on these frozen wastes for years, awaiting revelation. It is not by chance alone that you have appeared here."§!

We recognized the alien as a Zroni, a member of a psionically gifted race that lived in our own universe millions of years ago. Perhaps this rift was a doorway to a parallel timeline in which the Zroni still exist.

The alien spoke again within our minds:

§E"Thank you for accepting my invitation, we have much to discuss."

"I am known as the Far-Seer. I have been meditating on these frozen wastes for years, awaiting revelation. It is not by chance alone that you have appeared here."§!

descriptions.zh:
我们将视野锁定到行星上最高的山脉之一的一个点。

一个蒙面人坐在一个偏僻的山洞里冥想。她是有着灰色的皮肤的人形生物，被一种柔和脉动的能量的紫色光环笼罩着。

发光的角从外星人的头上长出来，同样的，但发育不良的刺从她的背部延伸出来。我们对这个物种并不熟悉，但它们一定对灵能波高度协调。

外星人又对我们脑海说话了：

§E“谢谢你接受我的邀请，我们有很多事情要讨论。”

“我被称为先知。多年来我一直在这些冰冻荒原冥想，等待启示。你出现在这里并非偶然。”§!
descriptions.en:
We traced the vision to a point on one of the planet's highest mountains.

A masked figure sat meditating in an isolated cave. Gray-skinned and humanoid, she was enveloped in a violet aura of gently pulsing energy.

Glowing horns sprouted from the alien's head, with similar, though stunted spurs extending from her back. We are not familiar with this species, but they must be highly attuned to psionic wavelengths.

The alien spoke again within our minds:

§E"Thank you for accepting my invitation, we have much to discuss."

"I am known as the Far-Seer. I have been meditating on these frozen wastes for years, awaiting revelation. It is not by chance alone that you have appeared here."§!

descriptions.zh:
先知继续说道：

§E“我一直在努力进入灵性维度。你们的人民将这个地方称为“虚境”。最近，我感受到了一种奇怪的呼唤，我相信它来自虚境深处。我现在站在第一次踏入这个神秘世界的门槛上。”§!

先知叹了口气。

§E“我的人民把这个责任托付给了我。进入虚境确实可以赋予我们巨大的力量，但我充满了怀疑。我越接近，虚境对我的拉力就越大。在内心黑暗的角落里有窃窃私语。这样的力量真的可以被控制吗？而现在，在选择的时刻，你出现了。这绝非巧合。”§!
descriptions.en:
The Far-Seer continued:

§E"I have been channeling my efforts to enter a spiritual dimension. Your people refer to this place as "The Shroud." Recently, I have felt a strange call that I believe has come from deep within the Shroud. I now stand upon the threshold of this mysterious world for the first time."§!

The Far-Seer sighed.

§E"My people have entrusted me with this responsibility. Entering the Shroud may indeed grant us great power, but I am full of doubt. The closer I come, the more the Shroud pulls at me. There are whispers in the dark corners of my mind. Can such power truly be controlled? And now, at the moment of choice, you appear. This cannot be mere coincidence."§!

label.en: Reveal the fate of the Zroni.

label.zh: 将我们知道的一切告诉这个泽洛族。
label.en: Reveal what we know of the Zroni.

label.zh: 我们只能提供我们的观点。
label.en: We can only offer our perspective.
It is not our place to intervene.

label.zh: 这样的精神追求是微不足道的。

descriptions.zh:
我们向先知解释了我们在对泽珞族文明的考古研究所学到的东西。

我们详细描述了全能的代价，以及它如何导致我们维度中的泽珞族之间的分裂，并描述了最终导致他们灭绝的激烈内战。

先知默默地考虑着我们的话。

§E“我在这里的努力真的会毁灭我们吗？如果突破虚境会导致灾难，那么进一步追求它就是愚蠢的。我的人民信任我。如果我谴责虚境是腐败的根源，我们的对飞升的渴望可能会被熄灭。但也许还有一种方法……有了你给我的知识，我可以以不同的方式接近虚境内的更高力量，预先阻止在你的维度中降临到我们身上的灾难。”§!
descriptions.en:
We explained to the Far-Seer what our archaeological research into the Zroni civilization had taught us.

We detailed how the price of omnipotence led to a divide among the Zroni in our dimension, and described the fierce civil war that culminated in their extinction.

The Far-Seer silently considered our words.

§E"Can it be true that my efforts here will doom us? If breaching the Shroud will lead to disaster, it would be folly to pursue it further. My people trust me. If I denounce the Shroud as a source of corruption, our desire for ascension may be quenched. But perhaps there remains a way... Armed with the knowledge you have given me, I could approach the higher powers within the Shroud differently, forestalling the disasters that befell us in your dimension."§!

label.zh: 这一次，或许会有所不同……
label.en: This time, it may be different...

descriptions.zh:
我们解释了泽珞族如何利用虚境飞升到更高的存在位面，超越物质需求并沐浴在近乎全能的乌托邦之中。这次飞升带来了重大挑战，但从物质和社会学的角度来看，这是一项巨大的成就。我们注意到，我们的学者尚未完全了解泽珞族的最终命运。

先知回应到：

§E“就好像任何维度的泽珞族都注定要进入虚境；这种命运超越了单一时间线的限制。也许这个选择从来都不是我们所能改变的。”§!
descriptions.en:
We explained how the Zroni used the Shroud to ascend to a higher plane of existence, developing beyond physical needs and basking in a utopian near-omnipotence. The ascension came with significant challenges, but from a material and sociological perspective it was a monumental achievement. We noted that the final fate of the Zroni is not yet fully understood by our scholars.

The Far-Seer responded:

§E"It is as if the Zroni in any dimension are destined to enter the Shroud; a fate that transcends the limits of a single timeline. Perhaps the choice was never ours to make."§!

descriptions.zh:
我们解释说，[Explorer.GetName]作为一种集体意识而存在，这样一个有意义的决定不应该留给个人选择。凡是对泽珞族社会整体有利的事情都必须是正确的决定，个人的不适不应该成为一个因素。

先知回应到：

§E“也许像你一样，从更集体的角度来看待这个困境是明智的。你建议我们如何进行？”§!
descriptions.en:
We explained that the [Explorer.GetName] exists as a collective consciousness, and that such a meaningful decision should not be left to individual choice. Whatever benefits Zroni society as a whole must be the right decision, and personal discomfort should not be a factor.

The Far-Seer responded:

§E"Perhaps it is wise to view this dilemma from a more collective perspective, as you do. How do you suggest we proceed?"§!

descriptions.zh:
我们分享了我们自己与神的关系的细节。对启蒙的追求是我们探索、寻找超越自身的意义并加深我们与宇宙的联系的原因。

先知回应到：

§E“在这方面你很像我们。泽珞族长久以来渴望超越物质世界，所以我有什么权利拒绝我的人民的飞升？作为寻求者，你建议我们如何进行？”§!
descriptions.en:
We shared details of our own relationship with the divine. The search for enlightenment is why we explore, to find meaning beyond ourselves and to deepen our connection with the universe.

The Far-Seer responded:

§E"You are much like us in that respect. The Zroni long to transcend the material world, so what right do I have to deny my people their ascension? As fellow seekers, how do you suggest we proceed?"§!

descriptions.zh:
我们解释说，客观的科学真理是我们定义自己在宇宙中的位置的方式。对知识的探索将我们带到了新的领域甚至更远的地方。它甚至让我们两个物种能够在不同维度相遇。

先知回应到：

§E“我们非常不同，我的人民。然而，即使您与我们的信仰背道而驰，您仍然充满尊重和聪慧。也许在这种情况下，您的观点是有明智的。作为世俗的人，您建议我们如何继续前进？”§!
descriptions.en:
We explained that objective scientific truth is how we define our place in the universe. The search for knowledge has taken us to new frontiers and beyond. It has even allowed our two species to meet from across dimensions.

The Far-Seer responded:

§E"We are very different, our peoples. Yet you are respectful and intelligent, even if your beliefs run counter to our own. Perhaps in this case there is wisdom in your perspective. As secular beings, how then do you suggest we proceed?"§!

descriptions.zh:
我们解释说，我们相信社会的目标是根据其原则发展和繁荣。在星系舞台上体现个人的价值观，才是对一个文明的真正考验。如果进入虚境确实是你们人民的意愿，那么你们就有责任继续前进。

先知回应到：

§E“我明白，但是我的人民的意志是分裂的。来自远方的旅行者，你能提供什么指导？决策的负担太沉重了，我一个人无法承担。”§!
descriptions.en:
We explained that we believe the goal of a society is to grow and prosper according to its principles. Embodying one's values on the galactic stage is the true test of a civilization. If entering the Shroud is truly the will of your people, you have a duty to proceed.

The Far-Seer responded:

§E"I understand, but my people's will is divided. Travelers from afar, what guidance can you offer? The burden of decision is too much to bear on my own."§!

label.en: Advise against interfering with the Shroud.
Encourage the Far-Seer to breach the Shroud.

descriptions.zh:
我们解释说，我们没有兴趣提供我们的见解，这也不是一次命中注定的拜访。我们是探险家，来到这个地方纯属偶然。

§E“很好。也许你决定不干预只是我要解释的另一个信号。那就走吧，睁大眼睛。”§!

泽珞族的历史很可能也会在这个维度重演，但他们的命运不是我们可以操纵的。

留下先知独自沉思，我们探索了附近的地形，希望我们在这里的旅程能带来一些实际的好处。没过多久，我们就在两座山峰之间发现了宝贵的矿藏。
descriptions.en:
We explained that we were not interested in offering our insight and that this is not a fated visitation. We are explorers, and have arrived in this place by complete chance.

§E"Very well. Perhaps your decision not to intervene is simply another sign for me to interpret. Go then, with eyes open."§!

It is likely that the Zroni's history will repeat itself in this dimension as well, but their fate is not ours to manipulate.

Leaving the Far-Seer to her meditations, we explored the nearby terrain in the hopes that our journey here would yield some practical benefit. It was not long before we uncovered a valuable cache of minerals between two peaks.

descriptions.zh:
我们这次阻止了先知进入虚境，她接受了我们的建议作为预言。作为感谢，她给了我们一个小而重的数据晶体。我们拿上它并离开了。

对数据晶体的分析揭示了一个微妙的变换矩阵；以灵能形式存储的庞大档案。

尽管晶体是一个奇怪的工程样本，但我们将其数据库转化为更有用的能量形式。
descriptions.en:
We discouraged the Far-Seer from entering the Shroud at this time, and she accepted our advice as prophecy. As thanks, she offered us a small yet oddly heavy datacrystal. We took our leave.

Analysis of the datacrystal revealed a subtly shifting matrix; a vast archive stored as psionic energy.

Though the crystal was a curious example of engineering, we converted its databanks into a more useful form of energy.

我们在两山之间的山谷中发现了一个巨大的矿藏，埋藏在水晶落石之下。地面太不稳定，无法开展全面的采矿作业，但我们使用有限的设备从矿床表面开采我们能开采的东西。

凭借大量宝贵的资源，这次探险取得了成功。
descriptions.en:
We discovered a vast mineral deposit buried beneath a crystal rockfall in a valley between two mountains. The ground is too unstable to develop a full mining operation, but we used our limited equipment to strip what we could from the surface of the deposit.

With a payload of valuable resources in tow, this expedition was a success.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§Y[From.System.GetName]§!中探索时，我们检测到一个完全光滑的太空舱从的裂隙中出现。

我们在那里遇到的泽珞族女祭司给我们发了一条消息。

§E“感谢[From.Explorer.GetName]的[From.Leader.GetName]给出的预言。从那时起我就避开了虚境的所有诱惑。以你们为榜样，我们自己学会了在星界位面间穿梭以寻找更多答案。我们正在分享我们的一些发现以表达感激之情。”§!

太空舱中含有大量来自其他平行维度的研究数据。
descriptions.en:
We have detected a perfectly smooth capsule emerging from the rift we explored in §Y[From.System.GetName]§!

The Zroni priestess we encountered there has sent us a message.

§E"Thank you [From.Leader.GetName] of [From.Explorer.GetName] for your given prophecy. I have since shunned all temptations of the Shroud. Following your example, we have ourselves learned to travel across the astral planes in search of more answers. We are sharing some of our discoveries in an expression of gratitude."§!

The capsule contained copious amounts of research data from other alternate dimensions.

The Zroni priestess we encountered there has sent us a message.

§E"Thank you [From.Leader.GetName] of [From.Explorer.GetName] for your given prophecy. I have since shunned all temptations of the Shroud. Following your example, we have ourselves learned to travel across the astral planes in search of more answers. We are sharing some of our discoveries in an expression of gratitude."§!

The capsule contained copious amounts of research data from other alternate dimensions.

It seems there is at least one dimension in which this species may now survive.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§Y[From.System.GetName]§!中探索时，我们检测到一个完全光滑的太空舱从的裂隙中出现。

它包含一条简单的消息：

§E“感谢[From.Explorer.GetName]的[From.Leader.GetName]给出的预言。从那时起我就避开了虚境的所有诱惑。以你们为榜样，我们自己学会了在星界位面间穿梭以寻找更多答案。我们正在分享我们的一些发现以表达感激之情。”§!

太空舱中含有大量来自其他平行维度的研究数据。

descriptions.zh:
我们在§Y[From.System.GetName]§!中探索时，我们检测到一个完全光滑的太空舱从的裂隙中出现。

我们在那里遇到的泽珞族女祭司给我们发了一条消息。

§E“感谢[From.Explorer.GetName]的[From.Leader.GetName]命中注定的造访。我们不仅突破了虚境，而且泽珞族人口也开始永久迁移到虚境。它为我们提供了如此令人难以置信的力量与和谐，我们正在经历一个我们从未想象过的社会乌托邦！

在我们完全离开物质世界之前，我们想与你们分享我们的一些物质财富。”§!

看来这个物种现在至少有一个维度可以生存。
descriptions.en:
We have detected a perfectly smooth capsule emerging from the rift we explored in §Y[From.System.GetName]§!

The Zroni priestess we encountered there has sent us a message.

§E"Thank you [From.Leader.GetName] of [From.Explorer.GetName] for your fated visitation. We have not only breached the Shroud, but the Zroni population has begun to migrate into the Shroud permanently. It has provided us with such incredible power and harmony, we are experiencing a societal utopia the likes of which we could have never imagined!

We wanted to share some of our material riches with you before we departed the physical world entirely."§!

It seems there is at least one dimension in which this species may now survive.
